tools.description: List a character's controls with keyable channels, rotate orders, limbs and IK/FK state, and which way each axis moves a bone. Call it once per character before posing. Each control has its template key (fk.upperArm.L, ik.leg.R, cog — pass it back as is), display name, VRM bone, side (L = the character’s left), body part, keyable and locked channels (tx ty tz metres, rx ry rz degrees, sx sy sz factor, @attributes), rotate order and mirror control. Limbs list their IK/FK mode (legs are IK by default, arms FK), ikFk value, IK control, pole and FK chain. concise (default) lists the primary controls, counts secondary and finger controls per body part and the controls a limb’s mode hides (FK in IK) in `secondary`, and leaves attribute details out (their @channels are listed); pass bodyParts (e.g. ["fingers.L"]) to list a part completely. detailed adds axisHints — how the driven bone's tip moves for +10° on each rotation channel at rest ('rz': 'tip up 4.1 cm, forward 0.4 cm') — a label for humanoid joints ('elbow hinge; bend = ry−') and each bone’s rest direction in character space (+Y up, +Z forward, +X the character’s left).

tools.description: Undo or revert your own AI steps since a checkpoint (or given steps) without touching the user's edits. Pass exactly one of to (a checkpoint from history_checkpoint) or steps (your step ids). When your steps are the top of the undo stack they are undone (mode undo: the user can redo them); otherwise one new step "AI: Revert N steps" restores them (mode revert), keeping the user’s steps and skipping fields the user changed since (skippedFields).
